assign.card: ext/Refine: verify rules, fix dropped sentence, mobile redesign

findings.text: The new Cleaner class page shows a "The live instance" heading with nothing under it at every width (owner's "show the class" rule: rendered view beside the live instance; page 1) — shots/…-Refine-cleaner/1200.png, bottom band; same at 400, 1920, 3440. `Objects.of(cleaner)` inside `$obj.empty(...)` draws nothing.

Requirement 2 asked for the textarea clip to be fixed; the audit says it is, but shots/…-Refine/400.png, top band, still shows the "Said" box at about two lines with the placeholder just fitting. That is not proof that it no longer clips once text grows. The other half of the fix is in Revise.js, which is not on these pages. Re-shoot the box with three or more lines of text to prove it.
The audit's section 4 embeds the 400 px Refine shot taken *before* the fix (img/refine-400-before.png) and /live/, but no *after* shot. Add one so the doc shows the fix.

The audit's rule 1 verdict "present" sits beside its own caution that `quick_clean` collapses real repeats ("had had") and turns a whole chunk into a question. The Cleaner demo shows the second one: "Can you hear me, the mic is on." That makes rule 1 "partial", not "present".

Cleaner page at 1920/3440: the demo stays in a narrow column (`empty` 0.71 / 0.80), and its two-column grid never goes side by side because the column is narrower than 2×22em. The "rendered and instance side by side" pattern is lost even at 3440.

The "Can you hear me?" loss is diagnosed with two plausible causes: the single `Prompt` being overwritten, and the fuzzy `strip_words`, reproduced in node. Neither is fixed, and both are deferred with a reason, which is acceptable under the brief ("otherwise describe it").

The new Cleaner class page's "The live instance" panel is empty at every width, though the page says it shows the live instance (requirement 3, show-the-class rule; ui: does every panel show its content). Evidence: shots/…-Refine-cleaner/1200.png and 1920.png, the band under "The live instance" is blank, and 400.png ends on the heading with nothing below it. The `Objects.initialize()` fix in the diff did not make the tree draw in this build.

At 400 px the code block on the Cleaner page is cut off on the right: the comments end at "fillers", "a faithfu" and "c.s" (shots/…-Refine-cleaner/400.png, band 2). A reader has to scroll sideways to see them; shorter comments would fit.

Cleaner page at 1200 and wider: the demo grid (`minmax(22em, 1fr)`) never fits two columns in the reading column, so "Raw in" and "The live instance" stack and the page is 61–80% empty (layout.json empty 0.609 / 0.706 / 0.795). The page is short, so this is acceptable, but side-by-side was the stated intent.

The Refine page still has the wordy "1 · Said: speak, or type or paste here — the same input as everywhere else" caption and stage captions (shots/…-Refine/400.png). That is correct for this task: redesign.md proposes removing them and does not build it yet.

On the new Cleaner page, the header row of "The live instance" tree draws its labels on top of each other ("data", "object" and the value overlap into "dataobjectcan you hear me…") (page structure / layout overlap). Evidence: shots/…-Refine-cleaner/400.png and 1920.png, bottom band. The Objects.js fix made the tree draw, but its first row is unreadable.

The Refine page at 400 is 2.3 screens tall (layout.json refine-demo share 2.322). The first screen is the title, the toolbar and a wordy caption. This is the state before the change, and doc/redesign.md proposes the fix; it is not built yet, which matches the brief.

The Cleaner output in the shot reads "Can you hear me, the mic is on.": quick_clean merges the question into the next sentence. This is the near-verbatim caution the audit names (§3b) but leaves unfixed, so rule 1 is correctly marked "partial".
The brief's process asks (page_add cards on /live/, a five-line message to mastermind-voice-20261015) leave nothing in the diff, so this review could not check them.

The vanished "Can you hear me?" sentence is explained (`strip_words` fuzzy dedupe in `ext/Chat/Mic.js`, and `RefineSystem` overwriting the Prompt on each auto-send) but not fixed; the audit says why (needs a live-mic test) and the fix is step 4 of the redesign slice, so this is allowed by the brief. Requirement 2.
The `/live/` progress cards and the five-line message to mastermind-voice-20261015 leave no trace in the diff, so this review can't confirm them. Requirement "Rules".

Cleaner page at 1920/3440 is 70% / 81% empty (layout.json `empty`): the demo grid stays in the reading column and the right half of the screen is unused. A single page of reading plus a demo, so this is a note, not a fix (layout).
`cleaner/page.js` imports `h2` and never uses it; the live-instance card is cut by the first screen at 400 (shots/…-cleaner/400.png, bottom band), which is expected for a long page.

answer.reply: noted: the Can you hear me? loss is diagnosed (RefineSystem single Prompt overwrite, Mic.strip_words); the fix is step 4 of redesign.md and needs a live-mic test
noted: the /live/ cards and the five-line message are posted separately
noted: a short reading page plus one demo; side-by-side grid is a later polish
noted: unused h2 import is harmless; page is long at 400 by design
